provenance: Support base plus the captured staged-comparison harness/tests/docs. All 68 workstation inputs matched the frozen snapshot before publication edits; library source and compiled classes match retained b227ede.

environment.cpu: Intel Core i5-4590S (4 cores, 4 hardware threads)

method.collection-order: All six permutations of find / tree-seq-find / collect, in three forward/reverse blocks
method.derived-total: Sum of the collection and replacement stage medians, not a measured end-to-end call or the median of sums
method.shared-baseline: The same six tree-seq-find JVMs per fixture are used for find and collect comparisons.
method.time-ratio: Clojure comparator / Pathling; omitted when any contributing stage observation is nonpositive

derived-totals.derivation: sum of separately measured stage medians; user batch work excluded; not an end-to-end measurement
